tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Block's Dessa is a voice artificial intelligence companion that can talk, laugh and cry like a human on MacBook. Confirmed by International Business Times Singapore, Dessa mimics human emotions using only voice, trained on human conversations.
App spending for artificial intelligence has surged 200-fold to $2B, driven by ChatGPT and premium subscriptions. Reported by Analytics Insight, the boom in artificial intelligence app spending continues to accelerate.
Reported by The Decoder, OpenAI is offering discounts up to 90 percent to poach Anthropic's biggest customers.
Washington bans Chinese artificial intelligence model DeepSeek while Microsoft abandons a major UK project. Reported by L'Orient Today, these are the week's key developments in artificial intelligence policy.
Reported by FAZ, OpenAI and Anthropic are shaping what artificial intelligence advertising promises to deliver.
Free every hour.
